name: dsh-layer-memory
description: Layered long-term memory for the DeepSeek Harness agent: working, persona, and fact layers with TTL/decay, scenario scopes, merge maintenance, store/recall/export/import tools, automatic prompt recall, a query-aware relevance-gated recall block, atomic write paths for long values, a management dashboard, memory import from other conversation logs, editable conversation or work-progress summaries, atomic project-handoff entries generated at the source (heuristic or model-generated), a configurable prompt digest budget, and retrospectives excluded from the automatic digest.
